description: FREE headline check of whether a submitted citation reference resolves in its register (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Submit one reference (PMID, DOI, or arXiv ID plus the claimed title, and optionally authors and year); get the signed verdict line only. Field-by-field detail and the register record are in the paid report. This service verifies that a submitted citation reference resolves in its register and whether the claimed fields match the register's record. It does not judge whether the cited work supports any claim made about it, and it does not grade the cited work.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the caller; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

reference.description: The submitted citation reference: { type?, id, claimed: { title, authors?, year? } }. type is optional (inferred from the id form: PMID, DOI, or arXiv). Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

name: refcheck_precheck
